finance.note: Historical capital/operating benchmarks are escalated to the as-of year at an ASSUMED 3% annually. Thereafter constant as-of-year real cash flows and an 8% real discount rate are used. These are screening estimates, not 2026 equipment quotations.

offtake.note: Liquid coproducts use a 90% saleable-volume assumption. Oxygen earns no revenue without offtake; conditioning cost is applied if sales are enabled. Prices are plant-gate proxy assumptions; Gulf Coast delivery costs are not independently quoted.

policy.note: No automatic 45Q, 45V or 45Z credit. DAC-to-fuel is carbon utilization; captured mass is not permanent removal. Any externally verified, levelized policy support must be supplied as one net annual-equivalent amount per kg SAF without double counting.

doe_pv_2025.note: Utility PV-only MMP 1.12 USD/Wdc and O&M 20 USD/kWdc-year. PV+240 MWh ESS on 100 MWdc is 1.81 USD/Wdc.

doe_pem_installed.note: Hub applicants' estimated installed PEM cost averages approximately 1900 USD/kW. Not the 2026 R&D target or a vendor offer.

doe_pem_performance.note: 55 kWh/kg system efficiency, 450 USD/kW stack cost and 40000-hour life. Equivalent-full-load replacement reserve is an approximation; dynamic aging is not simulated.

dac_unit_correction.note: The comment states 1100 USD/(tonne CO2/year) of nameplate capture. Conversion: 1100*8760/1000=9636 USD/(kg/hour), not 126. Assumes 8760-hour nameplate, not actual utilization. A supplier quote is still needed.

manuscript_costs.note: 3500/5000/2000 USD per kg/hour for RWGS/FT/upgrading. Dollar vintage assigned 2024. These conflict with old executable values; no supporting Aspen file or vendor quotes are present.

legacy_unverified.note: Storage costs and most process inputs retained as explicit assumptions. RWGS H2 is rounded to stoichiometric 2/28 kg per kg CO. No claim of independent Aspen validation.

battery_decomposition.note: (1.81-1.12)*100e6/240e3 = 287.5 USD/kWh at four hours. Assume power cost 120 USD/kW; energy residual 257.5 USD/kWh. Linear extension to 2-8 hour duration is an engineering assumption.

engineering_allowances.note: 3% annual escalation; PV 14% losses, 0.95 lifetime derating; H2/CO2 compression; heater costs; 80% heat recovery; catalyst/sorbent costs; storage flow limits; 20% process contingency; 15-year 60% battery replacement. FT heat 4.3 MJ/kg and upgrading heat 1.2 MJ/kg follow Model 2 README (divide by 3.6). DAC/RWGS thermal duties follow executable kWh/kg basis; unit conflict retained in sensitivity.

carbon_utilization.note: Utilization requires approved lifecycle analysis; no eligible displacement factor or project credit evidence is present.

solar_timezone.note: Timestamp localization uses metadata Time Zone, not Local Time Zone.
